phases.name: Architecture & Design
phases.description: Analyzed existing codebase and documented the technical approach for integrating Uploads as a dedicated group in the grouped mixin dropdown. Identified key injection points: toolbarComboState.groups after YAML parsing in loadComboOptionsFromYaml(). Defined Uploads group structure with isUploadsGroup flag. Documented positioning logic (top if uploads exist, bottom if empty), group header rendering strategy (Upload button instead of checkbox for Uploads group), and state synchronization mechanism via refreshUploadsGroupAfterStorageChange().

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clear diagram/pseudo-code showing group injection flow (YAML parse → inject Uploads → render dropdown)
Identified exact code location where groups are set up (line number + function name)
Group header rendering template identified and strategy for conditional upload button documented
Positioning algorithm documented: top if uploads exist, bottom otherwise
Identified how group checkbox suppression will work (DOM check? CSS? JS flag?)
State sync strategy documented (when/how to refresh group after upload action)

phases.name: Implement Group Injection Logic
phases.description: Implemented core functions for Uploads group management: buildUploadsGroup() creates synthetic group from localStorage, injectUploadsGroup() manages injection with positioning logic (top if items exist, bottom otherwise), refreshUploadsGroupAfterStorageChange() rebuilds and refreshes UI. Modified renderGroupedToolbarComboDropdown() to conditionally render Upload button for Uploads group instead of select-all checkbox. Group items follow same format as other groups. Existing filter/search logic applies automatically.

acceptanceCriteria.text: injectUploadsGroup() function created and tested with mock data
Positioning logic correctly places Uploads group at top if items exist, bottom if empty
Group checkbox not rendered for Uploads group (other groups' checkboxes still visible)
Upload button appears in Uploads group header with correct text and styling
Upload button click triggers triggerToolbarComboUpload() successfully
After new upload added, Uploads group automatically refreshes with new item
Existing uploads in localStorage appear in Uploads group on page load
Filter input correctly searches/filters items in Uploads group

phases.name: Integrate Upload Button Handler & State Management
phases.description: Wired Upload button click handler via attachGroupEventHandlers() to call triggerToolbarComboUpload(). Modified triggerToolbarComboUpload() to call refreshUploadsGroupAfterStorageChange() after successful upload to ensure new item appears immediately. Updated refreshComboAfterStorageChange() to refresh Uploads group when items are deleted via Manage Uploaded Mixins. Group collapse/expand works via existing toggleGroupCollapse() mechanism. Individual items can be selected/deselected normally. Filter and search apply to all groups uniformly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Upload button click handler is attached and calls triggerToolbarComboUpload()
After successful upload, Uploads group immediately shows new item in dropdown
Uploads group can be collapsed/expanded without errors
Individual uploaded items can be selected and deselected from dropdown
Selected uploaded items appear in 'Selected Mixins' panel correctly
Filter/search input works on Uploads group items same as other groups
No JavaScript console errors during upload flow

phases.name: UI Styling & Polish
phases.description: Added CSS styling for Upload button in group header with class .toolbar-combo-group-upload-btn. Button uses blue theme (#0066cc) consistent with the UI, includes hover (#0052a3) and active (#003d7a) states. Proper spacing and margin maintained relative to group header elements. Button text 'Upload' is clearly visible and clickable. Empty Uploads group appears cleanly at end of list when no uploads exist.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Upload button appears in Uploads group header with clear visual style
Upload button is properly aligned with other header elements (toggle, name)
Upload button has readable text and is clearly clickable
Hover/focus states on Upload button are visible
Empty Uploads group appears cleanly at end of list
Button text 'Upload' fits without truncation or overflow on standard viewport sizes

phases.name: Integration Testing & Validation
phases.description: Code implementation completed and verified. Build and tests pass successfully. All JavaScript changes are syntactically correct and integrated with existing infrastructure. Group positioning, rendering, and state management are properly wired. Upload button event handlers are attached correctly. CSS styling is applied. Implementation follows existing code patterns and maintains backward compatibility with flat format dropdowns and existing upload infrastructure. Ready for manual UI testing to verify end-to-end functionality.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Uploads group appears at top when uploads exist, at bottom when empty
Upload button in group header is clickable and triggers upload dialog
New uploaded items appear immediately in Uploads group after upload
Uploaded items can be selected and deselected from dropdown
Selected uploaded items appear in 'Selected Mixins' panel and affect diagram
Uploads group can be collapsed/expanded without errors
Filter/search works correctly on Uploads group items
Uploads persist across page reloads
'Manage Uploaded Mixins' button still works and syncs with Uploads group
No JavaScript errors in browser console during any test scenario

knownLimitations: Phase 5 (Integration Testing) consists of manual UI testing only - no automated browser tests exist in the project
